description:
Fix bibliographic metadata for three specific papers where the DOI (Digital Object Identifier) was incorrectly imported into the 'Extra' field.

Your task is to:
1. Locate these three papers:
   - 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al.)
   - 'Deep Learning' (LeCun et al.)
   - 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks' (Krizhevsky et al.)

2. For EACH paper:
   - Check the 'Extra' field in the right-hand Info pane. You will see text like 'DOI: 10.xxxx/yyyy'.
   - Copy the DOI string (only the number/code part, do NOT include the 'DOI: ' prefix).
   - Paste it into the 'DOI' field.
   - Delete the text from the 'Extra' field so it is empty.

The task is complete when all three papers have the correct DOI in the DOI field and an empty Extra field.

targets.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
